summary: MCP requests fail with 400 Bad Request when AAP uses a self-signed certificate; set mcp_ignore_certificate_errors=true (containerized) or IGNORE_CERTIFICATE_ERRORS in spec.mcp.extra_settings (operator).
questions: Why does the Ansible MCP server return 400 Bad Request?
How do I make the MCP server ignore self-signed certificates?

answer_card.title: MCP 400 with self-signed certs
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Containerized**: `mcp_ignore_certificate_errors=true`
- **Operator**:
```yaml
spec:
  mcp:
    extra_settings:
      - setting: IGNORE_CERTIFICATE_ERRORS
        value: true
```
